run_left_hand_mesh_recovery: run the demo script to recover left hand 3D mesh from input images using InterWild
run_get_model: run get_model with test mode to initialize the InterWild network for inference
run_generate_patch_image: run generate_patch_image to crop and resize an image region using a bounding box
run_render_mesh_orthogonal: run render_mesh_orthogonal to render a 3D hand mesh with orthogonal camera projection
run_vis_keypoints_with_skeleton: run vis_keypoints_with_skeleton to draw 2D hand keypoints connected by skeleton lines on an image
